description: Professional mastering preset definitions with concrete DSP targets, true-peak limiting, dynamic EQ, stereo management, clipping, saturation and QC.

architecture.principle: Presets define targets and limits; the DSP engine must adapt gain reduction and processing intensity to the source audio.
architecture.important: Numeric targets are starting points, not guarantees of a professional-sounding master. The engine must analyze the incoming audio and avoid unnecessary processing.
